description: Read-only agent review pipelines — named sequences of diagnostic agents that fan out and aggregate into one report. be-pre-merge-review is run by the /be-pre-merge-review command; be-prod-readiness is run by the /be-prod-readiness command, as step 1 of the be-path-to-production skill. Every step references a real agent in agent-os/agents/ (eval-enforced). Diagnostic→procedural handoff: each finding names the procedural skill that fixes it (agent finds, skill fixes).

be-pre-merge-review.description: Read-only review of the current diff before merge. The steps whose `when` matches the diff run at once, in the background; each returns findings in REVIEW.md → Findings format.

when.be-rls-reviewer: a *.schema.ts, migrations/*.sql, *.repository.ts, worker, processor, queue or src/infrastructure/database/ file changed
when.be-idempotency-reviewer: a *.routes.ts, *.controller.ts, billing or Stripe file changed
when.be-production-hardening-reviewer: diff mode — a src/infrastructure/, src/shared/middlewares/ or src/shared/config/ file changed, or auth, RLS, billing or token code: src/domains/auth/, src/domains/billing/, src/infrastructure/database/contexts/, migrations/*.sql, src/shared/utils/security/

be-pre-merge-review.aggregate: one report in REVIEW.md → Findings format — sorted by severity (critical first), duplicates merged, Skip paths dropped, at most two nits

be-prod-readiness.description: Full production-readiness sweep before a release/deploy.
be-prod-readiness.aggregate: satisfied items, blocking gaps, optional improvements
